svg.text: The service bay and a Casakin-class battlecarrier, at true scale · bow to the left · after the Master Specification, Rev 160
the service bay fills the keel of the industrial belt, under the foundries
service bay 2,400 m · heavy berth and frigate dock · keel doors underneath
docking arms on the ventral flanks
Keep and command island, forward midships
three door sets under the industrial belt: the heavy berth's and the frigate dock's either side
looking forward, at the cargo bays
hall 680 m wide · heavy berth 400 × 300 m · frigate dock 140 m a side
dorsal launch mouths, her own wing
Ballista turrets: four on the centerline, two on each shoulder
deck house over the jump-drive core
transit deck in both flanks: launch forward, recovery aft
A vacuum hall 2,400 × 680 m fills the keel of the industrial belt, with the
foundry floors stacked over it and feeding straight down.
Down the middle, 400 m wide: one Casakin at a time for refit or battle
damage, or a hull brought in for salvage and cut up for the furnaces above.
Along both sides: sixteen Corricks in two tiers of four, each side with its
own keel doors, so frigates launch whether or not a Casakin is in.
Kangeths berth in the cargo bays on the flanks above; the Casakins live
